job_description:
Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Alternative Data Strategy

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

The Alternative Data Strategy team drives credit decisioning forward by integrating non-traditional datasets into US Card strategies. As a Data Scientist, you will evaluate emerging vendors and data products, engineer high-impact features, build scalable processing and monitoring systems, and serve as the dedicated data domain expert guiding all users on dataset applications. In this role, you will also navigate risk governance for vendor models and build challenger models using new data to enhance existing ones. The scope involves rich cross-functional collaboration and continuous learning opportunities.

Role Description

In this role, you will:
• Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
• Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
• Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
• Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals
• This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

The Ideal Candidate is:
• Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
• Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
• Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
• Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
• A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

Basic Qualifications:
• Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
• A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analytics
• A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration

Preferred Qualifications:
• Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics), or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)
• Experience working with AWS
• At least 2 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R
• At least 2 years’ experience with machine learning
• At least 2 years’ experience with SQL

As a data scientist, you’re excited at the prospect of unlocking the secrets held by a data set, and you’re fascinated by the possibilities presented by IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. Summary Of The Job

The Sr. Director, Advanced Data Scientist will provide senior strategic and technical leadership within the Partnership Division's data science and modeling function. This role is responsible for defining and executing multi-year modeling roadmap and overseeing the development and implementation of advanced machine learning models that support credit decisioning and portfolio management. The successful candidate will combine deep quantitative expertise with the organizational influence and executive presence required to shape strategy, drive cross-functional alignment, and deliver measurable business impact at scale.

About This Role

• Vision and Strategy
• Define and own the multi-year modeling roadmap for the development of several critical custom credit-risk acquisition and portfolio management models, establishing strategic priorities, sequencing, and investment rationale aligned with Partnership Division business objectives.
• Serve as a senior thought leader and decision-maker on modeling approaches, leading discussions with senior business, credit risk, first line of risk, compliance, and technology stakeholders to align methodology, priorities, and risk considerations.
• Identify and evaluate emerging modeling capabilities, analytical approaches, and implementation methods that can expand the division's competitive advantage in credit decisioning and customer risk management.
• Communicate modeling strategy, project status, and key results to senior leaders through clear, executive-ready reporting — translating complex quantitative findings into actionable business insights and ensuring leadership has the visibility needed to make informed decisions.
• Model Development
• Independently design and develop advanced ML models for credit card acquisition and underwriting and account management and customer risk.
• Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to large-scale customer and credit datasets.
• Evaluate and implement algorithms including gradient boosting, random forests, neural networks, generalized additive models, ensemble methods, survival models, and other advanced ML approaches.
• Conduct fair lending analysis (e.g., least discriminatory analysis).
• Identify opportunities to improve model performance, stability, interpretability, and business value.
• End-to-End Model Ownership
• Independently lead model-development projects from problem definition through production implementation.
• Translate business objectives into well-defined modeling frameworks, target variables, populations, and performance criteria.
• Perform feature engineering, variable selection, model development, hyperparameter optimization, and performance evaluation.
• Establish appropriate training, validation, and out-of-time testing strategies.
• Document modeling methodology, assumptions, limitations, and results.
• Partner with model validation and model risk management teams to address challenges and incorporate feedback.
• Advanced Analytics and Research
• Conduct research on emerging ML techniques and assess their applicability to credit risk.
• Develop innovative approaches for extracting predictive signals from traditional and alternative data sources.
• Investigate nonlinear relationships, interactions, customer behavior patterns, and temporal dynamics that may not be captured by traditional credit-risk models.
• Develop interpretable ML approaches that balance predictive performance with regulatory and business requirements.
• Explore techniques such as explainable AI, causal modeling, ensemble learning, semi-supervised learning, and automated machine learning where appropriate.
• Model Performance and Monitoring
• Develop model performance and stability monitoring frameworks.
• Monitor predictive performance, population shifts, variable stability, and model degradation.
• Identify emerging risks and recommend model recalibration, redevelopment, or replacement when appropriate.
• Conduct ongoing research to improve model performance and robustness.
• Technical Leadership
• Serve as a subject-matter expert in advanced ML and credit-risk modeling.
• Establish best practices for ML model development, testing, documentation, and deployment.
• Stay current with advances in machine learning, credit-risk analytics, and regulatory expectations.

• PhD strongly preferred, particularly for candidates with strong research experience in machine learning, statistics, or quantitative finance.

• Strong experience independently developing predictive models using large and complex datasets.
